summary: Stop hunting through oily wall charts and half-broken calculators. Tap Drill Pocket gives machinists the tap drill, form tap, and clearance hole sizes they need in seconds.
features: Cut tap drill recommendations with adjustable thread percentage
Clearance hole fit options: close, normal, free
Inch, metric, UNC, UNF, NPT, NPS and common machine screw threads
Number, letter, fractional, and metric drill sizes
Custom drill kit: show the nearest sizes you actually own
Favorites and recent threads for repeated shop work
Works completely offline, with no account and no subscription
